review_method: Independent read-only source review; no tests or builds by reviewer.

findings.requirement: The deployed service must expose an operator-authenticated local-node quota increase and immediate resource retry, with bounded work and no integrity bypass.
findings.disposition: Assigned Claude isolated operator lane; HTTP Original, real quota recovery, deterministic wake and cancellation controls required.

findings.requirement: Tenant snapshot errors can disclose global counts and resource diagnostics.
findings.disposition: Review the authenticated tenant error boundary separately; F09 readiness-only claim is scoped to the public receiptQuerySnapshot health object.

findings.requirement: Quota/retry wake tests must distinguish explicit wake from expiration of the backoff timer, and cover cancellation.
findings.disposition: Required under FINAL-F04-OPERATOR, with deterministic wake reason or epoch observation.

findings.requirement: Strengthen scheduler-independent recovery observations and distinguish generation changes from lineage replacement.
findings.disposition: Existing bounded liveness waits remain limited evidence. Operator controls will add deterministic wake evidence; broader test-observer cleanup stays separate.

findings.requirement: Public receipt snapshot health must retain its exact configured/state shape in unavailable and building states.
findings.disposition: Required additional controls in FINAL-F04-OPERATOR, using real quota-unavailable and explicit building observations.

findings.requirement: Forwarding isolation evidence must show authenticated progress while public admission is occupied and retain genuine Original failures.
findings.disposition: Original2F10failures are retained in a0PASS5FAIL combined campaign; actual producer14PASS and composed26PASS evidence is pinned in public-forwarding-qualification-20261009.json. A post-completion permit assertion alone is not proof; the concurrent authenticated writes with one old shared permit are the substantive control.

findings.requirement: Measure and reduce extra walker holds for quota and health telemetry without weakening integrity.
findings.disposition: No latency regression was measured by this read-only review. Keep this optimization and its required serving-latency evidence separate.

findings.requirement: Avoid last-owner snapshot database destruction on the async health caller, and assess transient readiness sampling contention.
findings.disposition: Narrow potential latency window, no demonstrated blocking outage. Preserve as a concrete lifecycle/telemetry follow-up.

findings.requirement: Assess repeated Ready-to-Capacity cycles resetting resource backoff and triggering bounded rebuild work.
findings.disposition: Current behavior follows successful-publication reset semantics and remains rate-bounded; measure realistic churn before changing retry policy.

findings.requirement: Assess how public-forward transport failure changes peer health used by authenticated routing.
findings.disposition: Existing shared peer-health policy is broader than admission isolation. Require a concrete transport/consensus contract and regression before changing it.

qualification: Every finding is retained. Required operator source and tests remain open. Follow-ups are not described as repaired or qualified.
